does: Takes one drawn die and the roll type; for every MaximumRollResult boost of that type on the roller lowers the die to its Result, for every MinimumRollResult boost raises it to its Result. A boost of an umbrella roll type covers the rolls under it.

evidence.says: With MinimumRollResult and MaximumRollResult (SkillCheck,20) on the host, GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's count saw both draws run (0 to 1, 1 to 2) and the check came 20/20 instead of the stream's 9/11 at count 0; this is the only function called on each drawn die between the draw and the keeping of one (read in code:eoc::roll::stream::RollManager::InternalRollDiceWithBoosts). A read watch on the boost's Result closed the game twice, so no read hit backs it. Independently: GK.Memory.Freeze of the Result (+0x1) of the host's attack pin's two boosts from 19 to 2 made the next fair melee attack miss plainly where 19 hit, and the function reads exactly those two components
A count-only probe on it shows six calls for three passive checks, one for each die of a pair, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105D15D inside the roll with boosts
With the result of a roller's minimum and maximum roll result boosts held at another number, an attack's die came at that number and a hit became a miss
It walks the roller's boosts and lowers the die to each matching maximum, then raises it to each matching minimum
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
